fr.question_text: Les contrôles confirment que le dépassement est possible. Quand dois-je actionner le clignotant gauche ?
fr.answer_a: Seulement lorsque je suis à côté de la voiture.
fr.answer_b: Après avoir franchi la ligne centrale.
fr.answer_c: Avant de me déporter, pour annoncer ma manœuvre.
fr.answer_d: Uniquement si un conducteur me suit.
fr.explanation: J’annonce mon intention avant de me déporter à gauche. Le clignotant informe les autres usagers ; il ne donne aucune priorité et ne remplace pas les contrôles de sécurité.

en.question_text: My checks confirm that overtaking is safe. When should I use the left indicator?
en.answer_a: Only when I am alongside the other car.
en.answer_c: Before moving out, to signal my manoeuvre.
en.answer_d: Only if another driver is behind me.
en.explanation: Signal the intention before moving out to the left. The indicator informs other road users; it gives no priority and does not replace safety checks.

visual_review: Reviewed learner still in right lane behind white car, dashed centre line and unobstructed opposite lane. Question explicitly establishes completed safety checks and tests signal timing, not inferred mirror coverage. C before moving out is uniquely correct in both languages; explanation denies indicator priority.
